entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent pixel RPG 4-column by 4-row walk sprite sheet, original canvas 320x320, sixteen 80x80 cells. Edit target: provided sheet. Very subtly refine only shading on the existing dark-skinned bald base character, preserving the exact pose, facial identity, skin tone, direction and silhouette of every individual frame. Four directions remain in the exact row order and all four movement frames remain in exact column order. Keep all feet, hands, head and body anchors pixel-aligned in their existing cells. No clothing, hair, accessories or new features; this base must be overlaid with existing game clothes and hair. Keep all empty and transparent areas transparent, all original margins, cell dimensions, alignment and duplicated frames. Do not move, resize, merge, add or remove any frame. Retain the small pixel-art style and original palette. The same shading should remain consistent through the entire walking loop.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game battle sprite. Edit the provided exact Bulbasaur sprite, original 288x288 canvas. Improve only restrained interior shading/detail while preserving its original pixel-art identity, green/turquoise palette, red eyes, crouched pose, green bulb and the two long curling vine loops exactly as shown. Preserve the exact silhouette, alpha contour, visible size, feet, face, vine paths, body position and empty margins. No new pose, limbs, leaves, markings, particles, cast shadow, backdrop, text or objects. Keep the same subject at the same coordinates on a transparent canvas, with the same original pixel boundaries. The original custom pose and curling vine loops are essential; do not substitute a generic Bulbasaur drawing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent RPG trainer throw-animation strip, original 800x160 canvas with exactly five 160x160 frames arranged horizontally. Refine only extremely subtle fabric and hair shading inside the existing Red trainer pixels. Preserve every frame's exact pose, facing, hand and head position, red cap, yellow backpack, blue shirt, original palette, silhouette and transparency. Keep five frames in their current order and all character anchors/margins/cell boundaries identical. Keep duplicated final frames identical. No extra frame, new accessory, changed gesture, motion blur, text, background or moving body part between cells. Keep the original pixel-art style and a perfectly consistent outfit through the throwing sequence.
entries.reason: Current pbCreateTrainerBackSprite renders the layered front portrait; the five-cell back strip is retained as a legacy asset. No expected clarity gain from adding fabric noise.
